_meta.notes: This is a TYPED (born-digital fill, laser-printed then scanned) filing, the cleanest in the chunk. Cover: Nathan Evershed, Office and Office Sought both 'Salt Lake County District Attorney', party Republican, District Number left blank (a county-wide office) — agrees with the chunk file. Signature date 9/15/18 agrees with the chunk file's 2018-09-15; clerk stamp RECEIVED SEP 17 2018. NEITHER amendment box is checked — is_amendment honestly blank. The Summary Page and both stubs carry last name 'Evershed' and Date of Report '9/15/18'; the Page/of box is left blank on every page. SHAPE: attachment-behind-stub on both sides — the county Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p7) grids are present, each carries the single line 'See Attached' in the first Name cell, each leaves SUBTOTAL blank, and each carries the grand TOTAL. ⚠ MECHANICAL FINDING FOR THE WAVE: the two attachment blocks inside this one PDF are stored at OPPOSITE rotations — the Schedule A pages (4-6) needed a clockwise rotation to read, while the Schedule B pages (8-10) render UPRIGHT in the portrait frame (a verification crop of p8's row-1 band read correctly with no rotation at all). The brief's 'the sign is per file' warning is too coarse: it can vary per page-block within a file. Geometry is emitted in the un-rotated portrait frame for both, so a p4-p6 row is a narrow VERTICAL strip and a p8-p10 row is a horizontal BAND. SCHEDULE A COLUMNS: Date Received | First Name | Last Name/Organization Name | Address | City | State | Zip Code | Occupation/Employer | Method | Date Deposited | Contribution Amount — richer than the county grid. donor_raw joins the two name cells. ⚠ PRIVACY: the Address/City/State/Zip columns are covered end-to-end by one county redaction bar on all three pages, so donor_city/donor_state are blank with 'redacted at source' — a DIFFERENT fact from the filer leaving them empty. Occupation/Employer survives the bar and is captured verbatim where filled. The 'Method' column is the in-kind marker on this filing: 38 contribution rows say 'in kind' (or 'In kind') and carry in_kind=true; there is no in-kind column on the county grid and none was inferred. SCHEDULE B COLUMNS: Date of Expenditure | Name of Recipient | Purpose | Amount — no address column at all, so nothing to redact. Two contributor surnames carry a QUESTION MARK the FILER typed himself ('Branan?', 'LeMay?'); kept verbatim and flagged. Four rows have no first name and are organizations (FOP, Rocky Mountain Engineering, Salt Lake County Republican Par[ty] — the last is cut at the cell edge by the redaction bar — Stephen McCaughey LLC, The Law Office of John K. Johnson, Utah Values Pac LLC); each is flagged needs_review. No page of this filing is a dissolution notice, bank statement or ghost page.

Tested per the DeBry rule: the schedule grand total equals Column A (the period), NOT Column B ($134,241.69), so there is no basis inversion here.

Again Column A, not Column B ($62,137.85).

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' figure exists anywhere on this filing — both county stubs print the label with the cell blank, and the filer's attachment prints no per-page subtotals. The available gate is therefore the ATTACHMENT'S OWN printed grand Total on its last page (p6 $58,835.86 / p10 $28,524.54), which is also carried into the county stub and the Summary Page. Both sides close on it EXACTLY. A second, independent cross-check fired on the in-kind rows: every Schedule A row whose Method column says 'in kind' has a same-date, same-amount Schedule B counterpart (Mary Carr 35.00 Refreshments, Christine Sunderland 65.00 Refreshments, FOP 500.00 Dinner, Josh Player 335.76 Parade Supplies, Sandi Johnson 871.89/129.43/97.93, and so on) — which also proves the row-to-amount alignment on the rotated attachment pages.
